stations.title: Kasimir
stations.say: I want one list that grows.

stations.title: One per ticket
stations.text: A variable for each ticket, and one short.

captions: Kasimir wants every ticket at his bench in one list, in the order they came in.
With a variable per ticket, the day a ticket more comes in there is no room for it.
You keep the queue in a vector, and read and change it by position.
Now every new ticket joins the end of the queue, and the count follows it.
The bench has its list now. Next, Kasimir wants to go through it, one clock at a time.
